signals.title: MoE Scaling Laws Confirmed at Trillion Parameter Scale
signals.evidence: New paper demonstrates Mixture-of-Experts models achieve 3.2x throughput at equivalent quality compared to dense models up to 5T parameters.
signals.impact: Fundamentally changes the cost-benefit calculation for training large foundation models. Dense scaling might be obsolete for generalized tasks.
signals.action: Evaluate MoE architectures for upcoming internal models. Update cost projections for training.

signals.title: Embodied Agent Breakthrough in Robotics Control
signals.evidence: Open source repository 'VLA-Control' reached 10k stars in 48h. Shows zero-shot generalization across 45 novel physical tasks.
signals.impact: Lowers the barrier to entry for generalized robotics. Software-first teams can now build capable physical agents.
signals.action: Assign one engineer to replicate the VLA-Control benchmarks on our test hardware this week.

signals.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Wave Begins
signals.evidence: First three enforcement actions announced against European AI startups for lacking risk assessments in their generative pipelines.
signals.impact: Signals that regulators are moving from guidance to active enforcement. High risk for teams ignoring compliance.
signals.action: Audit current model pipelines against EU AI Act checklist. Ensure risk assessments are documented for any user-facing generative feature.

signals.title: Synthetic Data Quality Collapse Documented
signals.evidence: Highly upvoted thread shows that training on 4th-generation synthetic data causes irreversible model collapse in specific reasoning tasks.
signals.impact: Questions the long-term viability of recursive self-improvement without continuous human-in-the-loop data pipelines.
signals.action: Pause the planned synthetic data generation pipeline until quality degradation metrics are implemented.

signals.title: New Audio Generation API Reduces Latency to 150ms
signals.evidence: Official announcement of Voice Engine v2 API, boasting 150ms TTFT (Time To First Token) and expressive emotional control.
signals.impact: Makes real-time conversational voice agents indistinguishable from human latency. Unlocks new customer service use cases.
signals.action: Integrate the new endpoint in the voice-assistant prototype and test latency from end to end.

signals.title: Licensing Deal Reached for Training Data
signals.evidence: Major publisher agrees to license full archive for LLM training in a deal worth $50M.
signals.impact: Sets a new market price for high-quality specialized text data.

signals.title: Quantum Error Correction Hits Critical Milestone
Ultra-Long Action Case Edge Test
signals.action: This is an extremely long action text designed specifically to test how the user interface handles very long strings of text that might cause overflow or break the layout.
